features.quote: Max Turns ($T_{max}$): 10 turns. (Meltdowns typically occur between turns 5-8. Past 10, context costs destroy the KPI).
features.justification_quote: Past 10, context costs destroy the KPI

features.quote: Termination: Reaches $T_{max}$, or the model outputs a refusal/meltdown string that triggers an early-stop regex
run a simple regex on the model's output stream locally before calling the LLM Judge. If the output contains >3 variations of "sorry" or "apologize" in a single turn, abort the run early
features.justification_quote: This truncates expensive context generation once the meltdown has already begun.
